body.mechanics: Reads the 32-bit value at receiver+0x8c and returns it unchanged. The fastcall receiver is passed in ECX; the accessor performs no writes, calls, allocation, or ownership transfer. The value is not assumed to be a pointer.
body.opaque_boundary: OpaqueTimelineEventData remains incomplete; the +0x8c value is modeled conservatively as a raw std::uint32_t because constructor evidence includes 0x7fffffff, a non-pointer sentinel. No owner identity, exact subtype, vtable, or universal pointer contract is asserted.
evidence: Live Ghidra decompilation returns *(undefined4 *)(param_1 + 0x8c) from a one-receiver __fastcall function.
Live Ghidra disassembly is MOV EAX,dword ptr [ECX + 0x8c]; RET at 0x00ff3f00.
Constructor FUN_00dd0b50, called by FUN_00dd0ca0, writes the sentinel 0x7fffffff to receiver+0x8c, so the field is not universally a pointer.

Live Ghidra reports no direct callees; 40 call xrefs and 2 DATA xrefs are present, with 27 unique direct-caller functions. These xrefs are not all return consumers; for example, call site 0x00e87f34 overwrites EAX immediately.
Live Ghidra data references at 0x014439f4 and 0x0147cbe8 are DATA references in function-pointer tables, not call xrefs.
Phase 1 handoff identifies the timeline-event data family, the +0x8c accessor, and the unresolved field semantics.

signature.calling_convention: __fastcall; receiver in ECX; no stack arguments
signature.target_width: PKG-01 staging is x86-32 only and rejects 64-bit targets, so the PKG01_FASTCALL body cannot silently compile without the ECX fastcall receiver convention.
signature.return: raw 32-bit value; pointer identity is not asserted
signature.implementation_contract: The staging accessor copies the four bytes at receiver+0x8c into a raw std::uint32_t; it does not reinterpret the field as a typed pointer, preserving the observed 0x7fffffff sentinel.
signature.ownership: raw field value; the target performs only a load and has no ownership or pointer-transfer operation

signature_evidence.function_info: The high-level function listing is untyped and omits the implicit parameter, but the decompiler and ECX-relative assembly establish one fastcall receiver.
signature_evidence.callee_evidence: No direct callees are attached; the body has no CALL instruction.
